title: The Mapmaker's Rain - Episode 1
synopsis: A mapmaker brings water to a drought-stricken town, then discovers that erasing ink cannot undo a flood or silence another author. Nia recognizes her presumed-dead mother handwriting in marks she did not make.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Nia drew a river. The town's dry wells began to fill.

phrases.text: Nia drew a river. The town's dry wells began to fill.

narration.speaker: apprentice
narration.text: Can you make it reach our street?

phrases.text: Can you make it reach our street?

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: She'd lost her mother to a river. This one would save the town.

phrases.text: She'd lost her mother to a river. This one would save the town.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: The map had room for a river. The town didn't.

phrases.text: The map had room for a river. The town didn't.

narration.speaker: nia
narration.text: Get everyone uphill. I'll erase it.

phrases.text: Get everyone uphill. I'll erase it.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Erasing a line was easy. Undoing a river wasn't.

phrases.text: Erasing a line was easy. Undoing a river wasn't.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Whoever held the other pen knew which house was hers.

suspense.strategy: Test the apparent solution and accept a concrete cost when it fails.
suspense.strategy_description: A mapmaker brings water to a drought-stricken town, then discovers that erasing ink cannot undo a flood or silence another author.

map_rule.statement: Lines drawn on the inherited map can alter the town landscape.

mother_lost.statement: Nia mother was lost in a river and has been presumed dead.

water.statement: The first drawn river restores water to dry wells.

bridge.statement: The new river destroys the town bridge.

evacuate.statement: Nia orders people uphill and chooses to erase the river.

persists.statement: The river persists after Nia erases her line.

other_hand.statement: Fresh handwriting appears while neither present character draws.

home.statement: The new strokes direct the river toward Nia home.

mother_hand.statement: Nia recognizes the new writing as her mother handwriting.

beliefs.assumption: Nia is the only person still drawing on this map.

goals.goal_nia: Use the inherited map to bring the town safe drinking water.
goals.goal_apprentice: Bring water to the family street without losing the town bridge.
goals.urgent: Stop the flood and get the townspeople onto high ground.
goals.cliff_goal: Stop the flood while finding whether her mother is drawing from somewhere else.

open.question: Is her mother alive, and why is the other pen steering water toward home?

reveals.evidence: Nia draws; the wells fill in an inset town view through the workshop window.

choices.action: Draw a river to supply the wells.
choices.reason: The town needs water and the inherited map changes the landscape.
choices.evidence: Nia draws; the wells fill in an inset town view through the workshop window.

reveals.evidence: Tavi sees the bridge disappear under water while Nia looks at her mother old pen.

consequences.effect: The river gives water but destroys a crossing.
consequences.meaning: A rescue has become a threat, echoing the river that took her mother.

reveals.evidence: Nia sends Tavi to warn the street and reaches for an eraser.

choices.action: Erase the river while Tavi sends people uphill.
choices.reason: She assumes removing the line will undo the dangerous water.
choices.evidence: Nia sends Tavi to warn the street and reaches for an eraser.

reveals.evidence: The erased map line fades, but the view outside shows water still rising.

consequences.effect: The flood continues after the erase attempt.
consequences.meaning: Undoing the drawing does not reverse what it set in motion.

reveals.evidence: Nia lifts both hands; new ink forms beside Tavi untouched pen.
The fresh river bends toward a house labeled with Nia family name.
Nia recognizes the curled signature beside the fresh stroke and stops erasing.
